rows.note: Use this as the everyday choice for stretching your muscles or limbs.

example.english: I stretch after running every day.
example.traditional: 我每日跑完步都會拉筋。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 paau2 jyun4 bou6 dou1 wui5 laai1 gan1

rows.note: Use this when pulling something longer or when a duration becomes longer.

example.english: This elastic can stretch a lot.
example.traditional: 呢條橡筋可以拉長好多。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 zoeng6 gan1 ho2 ji5 laai1 coeng4 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this when a physical feature extends from one place toward another.

example.english: The new road can stretch all the way from the city centre to the seaside.
example.traditional: 條新路可以由市中心一路延伸到海邊。
example.jyutping: tiu4 san1 lou6 ho2 ji5 jau4 si5 zung1 sam1 jat1 lou6 jin4 san1 dou3 hoi2 bin1

rows.note: Use this when making a limited supply last longer by using it sparingly.

example.english: If we stretch this bag of rice by using it sparingly, it should last a whole month.
example.traditional: 呢包米慳住用，應該夠食成個月。
example.jyutping: ni1 baau1 mai5 haan1 zyu6 jung6 jing1 goi1 gau3 sik6 seng4 go3 jyut6
